cross_list_overlap.pattern_observation: The strongest cross-list signal is the cluster of: (a) Memorial Pres / CTS / Missouri Presbytery PCA, (b) Tim Keller / TGC / Redeemer-network NYC, and (c) Scott Sauls / Christ Pres Nashville. All three of those nodes appear in Revoice + Warhurst-protest + AMR membership. A church is materially more likely to be soft-progressive on sexuality if its pastor is in two or more of these networks.

publicly_distanced_or_repented.note: Requested his endorsement be removed from Revoice site (per his own later statement to PCA peers); but ALSO subsequently left PCA in 2024 to pursue explicitly egalitarian ministry — i.e., the request-to-remove was tactical, not theological repentance.

notes: Total identified: ~58 individuals + 1 organizational endorser. Verification standard: every name listed has at least 2 corroborating sources OR is a Revoice-published staff member from revoice.org/staff or revoice.us/our-leadership/. Names with weaker single-source corroboration (e.g., Sam Haist, Zach Meyer, Greg Piken, Dan Chappell, David Gill, Amber Carol) are flagged in source_urls. Per-year breakouts for 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 are incomplete because Revoice has migrated their site multiple times (revoice.us -> revoice.org), Wayback access was blocked from this environment, and revoice21.com is offline. The most reliable years for FULL speaker rosters from public sources are 2018, 2019, and 2021 (the latter via Anne Kennedy/CRI review). PCA pastor cluster is heavily centered on Memorial Pres + CTS + Missouri Presbytery; secondary clusters at Apostles Uptown PCA NYC (Starke), Christ Pres Nashville (Sauls), and South City Church PCA St. Louis (Haist). Per Adam's MOOP rubric, the highest-value match patterns are: (1) directly-named Revoice speakers/board (Greg Johnson, Stephen Moss, Sam Haist, John Starke, Greg Coles, Misty Irons, Bekah Mason, Pieter Valk, Steven Cooper, Luke Calvin) and (2) public endorsers who have NOT retracted (Karen Swallow Prior, Mark Yarhouse, Andy Crouch, Matthew Lee Anderson, Scott Sauls, Jay Sklar).
